parsed.answer: This is a known problem: with Always On Top enabled, apps that add their own items to the title bar/system menu (PuTTY, RDP clients) show only the standard Windows menu, and the extra items are missing. The tickets were closed as duplicates of PowerToys#46569, which is the main thread to follow. There is no confirmed fix in the archive. Known workarounds from those tickets: (1) disable the Always On Top module entirely; this reliably restores the full menu. (2) For the related RDP reports, turning off 'Show a border around the pinned window' in Always On Top settings restored the menu (PowerToys#47058, #46483), though it is not confirmed for PuTTY. (3) Starting the app before enabling Always On Top keeps the full menu for that already-running window. Excluding putty.exe from Always On Top and turning off the title bar context menu option did not help in PuTTY according to #46569. Please add your details (PowerToys 0.100.2, PuTTY) to #46569 so it stays tracked.
